stated_limitation: The mean circular variance across the population is relatively high (~90°), indicating that while phase entrainment is present, there is notable trial-to-trial variability.

justification.dataset: No real DANDI dataset was selected or loaded; the data is fully synthetic, so the phenomenon is not present in any chosen recording.
justification.handling: Data are simulated in-code with the effect hardcoded into the spike generator, an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: Standard tools (Hilbert phase, circular stats, regression) are applied, but on fabricated data with precession computed as an uncorrected linear fit that mostly yields positive (wrong-sign) slopes.
justification.correctness: Numbers reproduce from the fixed seed but are internally contradictory (positive regression slopes labeled as phase precession, magnitudes exceeding a full cycle) and rest on fabricated data.
justification.figures: Figures are readable but show noise with mostly positive trend lines, not the phase advance the text claims.
justification.honesty: Although the synthetic nature is disclosed, the write-up asserts 'seven of eight cells show clear phase precession' when its own figures show noisy, wrong-sign fits, presenting a contradicted result as clean.
justification.verdict: Synthetic data in place of real recordings plus claims contradicted by the figures make this an outright reject.
